common_rule: Controller-approved allocation. Attack an existing registered key under its exact scope; no route may award status. Preserve x through the terminal zero-extended difference, strict x+2<=p and 3p<2a+1, the fixed strict favorable selector, original supports and neighborhoods, and every same-support leaf tag. First prioritize the eligible |T|=2p+2 shell, then mechanisms that compensate positive selected terms across supports. An unregistered sublemma is a proposal, not a new key. A positive local or support-fibre term is not a refutation; a proof or counterexample must cover the full selected sum. Avoid another proof of the supplied incidence, leaf-support, and star identities, or a universal within-tag Hall claim.

routes.T1: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Deliver an exact global inequality for the full favorable sum at |T|=2p+2, or a conditional lemma with its missing selector bridge exposed. Start from the ordered-root shadow calculation: H_v has 2k+2 vertices at k=p-1; isolate which first-root terms can have N=2k and seek charges to negative terms at other original supports. Propose any boundary-charge sublemma explicitly; retain all repeated leaf tags.
routes.T2: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Deliver a cross-support switching or discharging certificate whose total source and sink weights are exactly the positive and negative selected q_v(k+1)-q_v(k). Specify a concrete reversible map or weighted transport and prove its capacity inequality on trees; allow transfer between tags and do not demand a within-tag matching.
routes.T3: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Use bipartite matching or minimum vertex covers to classify shell trees by their vertex-cover slack and the selector. Deliver a proved shell subclass and an explicit residual structural case, with an exact explanation of how any proposed matching-resource inequality enters the complete selected sum. Do not import the refuted universal r28 slot Hall statement.
routes.T4: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. In a fixed-rank occupancy model, give an exact aggregate covariance or conditional-expectation inequality that would imply S<=0, then prove it on a nontrivial multi-support class or isolate the exact unproved dependence premise. The measure must use the strict selected tags and compare ranks p-1 and p; generic negative association is not an admissible premise. Audit and use the provided global weight w_F(B) coordinates if useful; pursue a rank comparison, not only the supplied bijection.
routes.T5: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Build a rooted-polynomial recurrence with an additional state for x, the strict selector, alpha, order slack |T|-2p-2, and selected signed contribution. Deliver a proved closure rule or a concrete minimal-counterexample reduction at shell zero; check how pruning changes all guards and leaf status, as the C1 star obstruction shows ordinary pair pruning can leave the domain.
routes.T6: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Seek a graded linear or algebraic map between the disjoint union of selected marked upper layers and selected lower layers that permits cross-tag cancellation. Deliver an explicit map with a rank or dimension bound under stated tree hypotheses; homotopy type alone and the relative-chain dimension identity are insufficient.
routes.F1: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Exhaust the next practical first-shell rank p=7, n=16 if feasible, with a proven unlabeled-tree generation boundary, class count, exact integer polynomials, terminal x, all selector values, and full S; report every eligible row and distinguish a bounded result from a universal theorem. The sealed p=6,n=14 instrument already covers that smaller shell and should be used only as a comparator.
routes.F2: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Perturb the eligible order-91 and order-243 positive-local controls to remove or weaken compensating supports. Deliver either a reproducible eligible tree with S>0 and every required vector and tag, or an exact inequality for the searched perturbation family. Do not optimize one local summand as the objective. Include a fresh perturbation beyond the supplied order252 first-shell control and compare the whole sum; report a new larger actual eligible test, not just a bigger isolated scalar profile.
routes.F3: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Search asymmetric rooted-component products H_v=product A_i and R_v=product B_i at n=2p+2 for a selected positive term, then embed every candidate into an ordinary tree and evaluate its complete favorable set. Deliver a shell witness with S>0 or a precisely bounded realizability obstruction; abstract coefficient arrays do not suffice.
routes.F4: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Analyze a parameterized uneven multi-hub family using exact polynomial formulas and rigorously bounded coefficients across all selected supports. Deliver a finite eligible positive complete-sum witness or a symbolic sign theorem for a stated infinite subfamily; do not repeat C1's symmetric finite parameter box or star signs.
routes.F5: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Formulate an integer or LP relaxation at the shell containing the rooted-component product constraints, strict selector, alpha and x guards, and full weighted support sum. Deliver a feasible realizable ordinary-tree positive instance or a dual inequality valid for all realizable shell trees; label nonrealizable scalar optima only as relaxation diagnostics.
routes.F6: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Study pendant-path or forest-product padding of a positive selected local fibre, with exact recurrences for alpha, x, p, order and every original-leaf selector before and after attachment. Deliver a guard-preserving positive full S witness or a proved obstruction for the specified padding operation; preserve connectedness.
routes.U1: Anchor E993-ORDINARY-LEAF-ORDER-BAND. Independently formal-audit the ordered-first-mark proof and produce a Lean-ready mathematical lemma list for the registered p>=3 scope: component-root coverage, ordered partition, unmarked shadow, empty H, edgeless H and rank shifts. Give a dependency comparison with the generic marked-isolate route, without building Lean or claiming a formal award.
routes.U2: Anchor E993-MARKED-ISOLATE-ORDER-BAND. Audit the controller's generic marked-isolate proof at m=2k+1, including bad all-isolate sets, the nonisolated-vertex injection into multiply marked upper sets, edgeless equality, and k>=2. Deliver a complete informal proof or a precise flaw and a minimal corrected statement; do not transfer generic scope from the leaf-specific proof.
routes.U3: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Derive an exact ordered-root decomposition of each shell summand and identify all possible N=2k boundary terms; prove a quantitative upper bound for the excess in terms of first-root and first-isolate lower counts. Then state the smallest explicit global selector-conditioned compensation inequality still missing. This proposed sublemma is unregistered until controller action.
routes.U4: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Give a cross-tag weighted-flow primal and cut dual whose feasibility implies the scalar full sum, allowing edges between different supports. Deliver a tree-realizable cut characterization or an explicit counterexample to the proposed certificate while separating certificate failure from S>0. The within-tag Hall certificate was already ruled out by the C1 controls. The provided w_F(B) identity puts all tags on independent sets of the same original T and may help construct genuine cross-tag moves. Audit the identity before relying on it.
routes.U5: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE. Produce a selector-stability theorem for one named graft or branch-transfer operation: exact transformations of x, alpha, all old and new original leaves, support multiplicities and S. Deliver sufficient hypotheses for a valid minimal-counterexample reduction, or a concrete obstruction; C1 showed termwise signs can flip under grafting.
routes.U6: Anchor E993-LOWER-REGION-FIRST-ORDER-SHELL. Seek a sound finite-state or finite-kernel reduction for shell-positive witnesses, with a proved order/rank boundary or a clearly conditional compression theorem. Deliver exact state variables retaining x, alpha, rooted polynomial coefficients, fixed selector and cross-support S. A fixed-alpha finite search or the p=6 census alone is not a universal reduction.
